sources.use: General role demands; local assessment tasks and thresholds are not official standards.
Needs analysis and positional context; no universal physical cutoff.
Coach-supervised competence progression; a gym result cannot establish scrum eligibility.
Coordinated jump/support and controlled return; local task procedure remains coach-authored.
Tracking, preparation, connection, acceleration, finish; no official numeric readiness score inferred.
Research distinguishes linear speed, planned direction change and reactive agility; local variants require separate reliability review.
Observational study in 29 senior international men; associations do not establish causation or club-level selection thresholds.

protocols.name: 10 m acceleration
protocols.procedure: Mark 0 and 10 m; fix start stance and start-line offset, timing trigger/gate height, recovery and trial count in the approved session sheet. Run without a ball. Retain every valid trial and the stated summary rule.
validityCriteria: Same start and timing method across comparisons; no slipping or early trigger; hand timing and gates are separate series.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: 20 m acceleration
protocols.procedure: Use a measured 20 m course with the same fixed start, timing and recovery conditions as the 10 m test. Record separate split definitions if collecting 10 m within the run.
validityCriteria: A 10 m split within a 20 m sprint is not automatically interchangeable with a standalone run.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: 40 m sprint
protocols.procedure: Measure a straight 40 m lane with safe run-off. Fix stance, timing trigger, recovery and trials before testing. Optional flying split needs its own definition and run-in distance.
validityCriteria: Record wind and surface; total sprint time is not maximum velocity.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: 505 turn — left
protocols.procedure: Use the conventional 505 layout: start 10 m behind the timing line, accelerate through it, turn at the line 5 m beyond it using the designated left plant leg, and return through timing. Record plant leg explicitly, fixed timing and trial rules.
validityCriteria: Foot reaches turn line; designated plant leg; record layout and invalidate wrong-side turns; modified 505 requires another definition.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: 505 turn — right
protocols.procedure: Use the conventional 505 layout: start 10 m behind the timing line, accelerate through it, turn at the line 5 m beyond it using the designated right plant leg, and return through timing. Record plant leg explicitly, fixed timing and trial rules.
validityCriteria: Foot reaches turn line; designated plant leg; record layout and invalidate wrong-side turns; modified 505 requires another definition.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Sprint-to-stop observation
protocols.procedure: Mark a fixed approach lane and stopping zone. Coach selects safe approach speed, fixes the approach distance and zone, and films front/side views. Record steps, trunk control, balance and zone completion; test both lead-leg patterns.
validityCriteria: Compare only at matched approach speed and layout; no universal stopping-distance cutoff.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Attacker-led tracking/evasion
protocols.procedure: Fix lane dimensions, attacker start, defender distance and allowed movements. Use balanced unpredictable left/right trials. Record cue, choice accuracy, false steps, tracking outcome and time only if equipment supports it. Begin without contact.
validityCriteria: Record attacker identity/speed and rep order; planned turns and generic phone reaction scores are separate constructs.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Countermovement jump
protocols.procedure: Use a consistent validated device and its method. Fix hands-on-hips condition, take-off/landing instructions and recovery; retain valid trials. Do not compare flight-time and jump-and-reach methods as equivalent.
validityCriteria: Hands remain in the specified position; stable landing; device and calculation method recorded.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Standing broad jump
protocols.procedure: Start with toes behind the line, two-foot take-off, stable two-foot landing; measure to the nearest heel. Fix arm-swing policy, trials and rest.
validityCriteria: No fall or extra step; record take-off/landing surface; this is an alternative measure, not convertible to CMJ.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Familiar lower-body strength test
protocols.procedure: Coach selects one familiar lift and fixed repetition target, technique/range, equipment and supervision. Save each lift/repetition variant as its own definition. Record completed reps and body mass separately; use a technique-limited submaximal test when maximum testing is inappropriate.
validityCriteria: Same lift, equipment, repetitions and range for retests; stop before loss of technique; estimated and actual 1RM remain distinct.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Familiar upper-body press test
protocols.procedure: Select a familiar supervised press with fixed repetition target, range and equipment; use safeties/spotters where required. Save bench, dumbbell and alternative variants separately.
validityCriteria: A press measures pushing capacity, not tackle competence; capture body mass and reps separately; do not convert push-up reps into bench strength.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Familiar upper-body pull test
protocols.procedure: Select a familiar supported row or other approved pull with fixed repetition target, range, body support and equipment; save variants separately.
validityCriteria: No momentum-assisted repetitions; specify external load versus total system mass for bodyweight variants.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Repeated sprint series
protocols.procedure: Coach fixes distance, number of reps, start interval, recovery mode and timing method in the protocol before testing. Store one time per rep in a named session. Retain all reps; compute best/mean/total only after completeness review.
validityCriteria: A changed interval/distance is a different protocol; missing reps are missing, not zero; percentage decrement alone is not a readiness decision.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Intermittent running recovery test
protocols.procedure: Choose one published test variant such as Yo-Yo IR1, retrieve its authorized instructions/audio and attach the exact setup, pace and termination rules before use. Do not mix variants.
validityCriteria: This candidate is not an administration manual; no interpretation until the full selected protocol is approved.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Overhead squat observations
protocols.procedure: Use existing descriptive capture: document depth, stance, footwear, view and actual observed compensations. Record not assessed where observation is absent.
validityCriteria: No automatic diagnosis, injury prediction or inference of weak/tight muscles from appearance alone.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Ankle knee-to-wall
protocols.procedure: Fix barefoot/footwear condition, foot alignment and wall setup. Keep heel down and record toe-to-wall distance with knee contact achieved; record left and right separately.
validityCriteria: Side is mandatory in the approved extension; current live scalar capture can only describe side in notes.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Single-leg control and landing
protocols.procedure: Coach fixes squat depth/support and an appropriate landing task separately. Record left/right control, trunk movement, balance and symptoms. Start with supported or low-demand tasks when appropriate.
validityCriteria: Different landing heights or tasks are separate conditions; asymmetry prompts review, not diagnosis.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Tackle in space and reload
protocols.procedure: Record tracking, preparation, connection, acceleration and finish separately, then legal release/get-up/reload. Begin tracking without contact; progress to controlled equipment/partner work only with qualified supervision and demonstrated prerequisites. Observe both shoulders.
validityCriteria: Record approach direction, opposition, pressure and coach prompts; no maximal collision contest; no fatigue progression before safe controlled competence.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Carry and ball continuity
protocols.procedure: Fix starting picture and opposition. Observe scan, footwork, carry/pass choice, ball protection and legal presentation or offload decision; begin with controlled contact level.
validityCriteria: Separate decision, technical execution and outcome; opponent mismatch cannot be interpreted as capacity.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Ruck arrival and decision
protocols.procedure: Use coached scenarios to observe arrival angle, legal entry, body control and compete/support/reload decision. Start with a walkthrough and record the permitted contact level.
validityCriteria: Current local laws and coach supervision required; no unsupported neck loading or uncontrolled clear-outs.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Role-specific scrum competence
protocols.procedure: Reference the existing Scrum Ready progression and current qualified coach review. Record exact role, stage demonstrated, body/bind control and unit context. Preserve separate front-row participation/competition authorization.
validityCriteria: Do not invent a stage from gym results; no machine or opposition progression without prerequisites; role changes require review.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Assigned lineout jump/lift role
protocols.procedure: Assign jumper/lifter/receiver role. Observe call, movement, timing, coordination, secure ball delivery and controlled supported return. Follow coached progressions before lifting people.
validityCriteria: Qualified supervision, suitable space and current local requirements; a high jump alone does not verify a lineout role.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Hooker throwing accuracy
protocols.procedure: Fix target distances/heights, ball, throw count and target window. Record attempts and accurate throws per target, timing and consistency; compare unopposed and pressured contexts separately.
validityCriteria: Define an accurate throw before testing; use stable targets and conditions; no universal percentage pass mark.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Number 8 base control
protocols.procedure: Under qualified coaching observe controlled ball management at the scrum base, link with 9, and pick/pass decisions first in an unopposed setup.
validityCriteria: Live scrum evidence requires approved scrum progression; distinguish handling from scrum authorization.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Scrum-half service and tempo
protocols.procedure: Use fixed pass targets and distances from a ground ball both ways. Record accuracy, delivery time if measurable, footwork and communication. Add changing distribute/carry/kick cues only after baseline service.
validityCriteria: Fix ball presentation and start cue; record decision accuracy separately from pass accuracy; 9 is part of backs coverage.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Attack and support decisions
protocols.procedure: Fix 2v1 or 3v2 starting geometry and vary a documented defender response. Observe scan, depth, timing, support line and pass/carry/kick decision.
validityCriteria: Keep opportunity, decision, execution and outcome separate; simulator evidence remains distinct from field execution.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Defensive alignment and communication
protocols.procedure: Use a documented defensive picture and team-coach objective. Observe numbering, spacing, connection, press/drift/hold decision and reload.
validityCriteria: Use generic public scenarios; retain club tactics in protected storage; successful outcome alone does not prove correct decision.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Aerial skill and backfield decisions
protocols.procedure: Fix kick type, distance, chase pressure and space. Start with uncontested catches; record positioning, communication, catch security, landing and next decision.
validityCriteria: Progress opposition only under coaching and applicable laws; high-ball confidence and catching skill are separate observations.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.

protocols.name: Role-specific kicking
protocols.procedure: Fix kick type, start position, target area, ball and pressure. Record target outcome, decision appropriateness and execution separately on each tested foot.
validityCriteria: Record wind and conditions; a longer kick is not automatically a better tactical choice.
protocols.interpretation: Raw result or factual observation only. No validated selection threshold or automatic prescription.
protocols.stopRule: Stop affected testing for pain, injury concern, unsafe execution or deteriorating control; follow existing referral and participation restrictions. Unknown readiness or pain requires review.
